title: Sunday School
summary: We will read and discuss Mark Chapter 4
details:
What kind of teacher tells stories that leave people scratching their heads? And what kind of person sleeps through a terrifying storm while everyone around him fears for their lives?

In Mark 4, Jesus talks about seeds, soil, and the mysterious growth of God's kingdom. Then, just when we think we're beginning to understand him, he calms a raging storm with a few words—and leaves his own disciples asking, “Who then is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?”

Join us as we explore a chapter filled with surprising stories, challenging questions, and a Jesus who refuses to fit neatly into anyone's expectations.

Here's your invitation: Don't just read about the questions Jesus raised 2,000 years ago—come wrestle with them yourself. Whether you've studied the Bible for decades or barely opened it, your questions and perspectives belong in this conversation. You don't need to prepare, and you certainly don't need to have the answers.

Make Sunday School part of your week. Bring your curiosity, bring your questions, and bring yourself. The conversation is better when you're part of it!
